source:
@@U00961@@
What is this vision?
What heavenly form do I see in this magic glass?
O Love, Love,
lend me your swiftest wings and
guide me to her,
lead me to her presence!
Ah, if I move from this spot,
if I dare to approach her by only a step,
it’s as if I saw her only in a mist.
How beautiful,
how unspeakably beautiful!
Can woman be so lovely?
I see in this reclining figure
the quintessence of all the heavens.
Does earth have anything to show more fair?

@@U00963@@
Of course!
When God slaves like a dog for six whole days
and then on the seventh cries Bravo!
there’s got to be something mighty clever there!
But go on, don’t let me stop you,
gaze away, look your fill for now.
I know just how to hunt down such a darling for you.
And happy the man lucky enough
to lead her home as his bride!
(浮士德 continues to look in the mirror, as 梅菲斯特
stretches out in the chair, plays with the whisk, and continues talking.)
Here I sit like a king on his throne,
scepter in hand,
and all that’s lacking is a crown.
(The MONKEYS, who have been performing all sorts of odd antics,
bring a crown to 梅菲斯特 with a great outcry.)

@@U00965@@
Oh, be so good, sir,
translation:
@@U00961@@
这个愿景是什么？
我在这块魔法玻璃中看到了什么天堂形态？
噢，爱，爱，
把你最快的翅膀借给我
引导我去找她，
带我去见她！
啊，如果我离开这个地方，
如果我敢靠近她一步
就好像我只在迷雾中看到了她。
多么美丽，
多么难以言喻的美丽啊！
女人可以这么可爱吗？
我在这个斜倚的人物中看到
诸天之精华。
地球还有什么比这更公平的吗？

@@U00963@@
当然！
当上帝像狗一样奴役了整整六天
然后在第七次喊“好极了！”
那里一定有一些非常聪明的东西！
但继续吧，别让我阻止你，
移开目光，暂时看饱了。
我知道如何为你追捕这样的宝贝。
祝这个人足够幸运
带着她回家，成为他的新娘！
（浮士德继续照镜子，正如梅菲斯特
躺在椅子上，玩弄搅拌器，然后继续说话。）
我像国王一样坐在宝座上，
手中的权杖，
所缺的只是一顶王冠。
（猴子们一直在表演各种奇怪的滑稽动作，
带着强烈的抗议给梅菲斯特戴上王冠。）

@@U00965@@
哦，你真好，先生，
